name: Casing head and casing spool
function: The permanent base of the wellhead that supports the casing strings on hangers and seals the annuli between them.

tabs.overview: The casing head is welded or threaded onto the surface casing. Each subsequent casing string hangs in a spool on a slip or mandrel hanger with a pack-off or seal assembly above it. Side outlets with valves give access to each annulus for monitoring and pressure testing.
tabs.engineering: API 6A flanged or studded connections; bowl profiles match the hanger type; secondary seals isolate the annulus from the flange connection.
tabs.connections: Below: surface casing. Above: next spool or tubing head. Side outlets: annulus valves.
tabs.safety: Annulus pressure is monitored during fracturing; a sudden change indicates a casing or hanger seal problem and stops pumping.
tabs.operations: Installed during drilling; tested before the frac stack is nippled up.
tabs.failure_modes: Pack-off leaks, hanger seal damage from proppant when no tree saver is used.

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
